papers.title_en: AutoOntic: Automatic Ontology Induction from Text for Knowledge Graph Construction
papers.authors: Alla Chepurova, Aydar Bulatov, Mikhail Burtsev, Yuri Kuratov
papers.evidence: 通过本体归纳提升GraphRAG的知识图谱质量
papers.tldr: 图检索增强生成依赖高质量知识图谱，但现有无模式LLM抽取常得到无类型层级、无域/值域约束的扁平图。AutoOntic自动规范化开放词表实体类型与关系，归纳类型层级并挖掘关系域/值域约束。在Text2KGBench两个子集上，超90%端点类型与参考类语义对齐；在MINE上检索准确率达88%。该工作为文本自动构建本体并约束KG构建提供了可复现流程。
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation depends on the quality of the knowledge graph (KG) it retrieves over, yet schema-free LLM-based extraction pipelines typically produce flat graphs: deduplicated entities and relations with no type hierarchy and no domain/range constraints. We present AutoOntic, a pipeline that automatically constructs an ontology from text by canonicalizing open-vocabulary entity types and relations, inducing a hierarchy over the canonicalized types, and mining relation-level domain and range constraints. Its hierarchy induction procedure prioritizes types using corpus-derived relation-argument profiles and places them through local, LLM-adjudicated parent/child checks, allowing newly inserted types to trigger reassignment of existing parent-child links. The resulting hierarchy constrains entity deduplication and supports the induction of relation-level domain/range constraints. For intrinsic evaluation, we introduce a reference-based protocol that classifies induced ontology types as exact, broader, narrower, or unrelated to reference domain and range classes. On the Wikidata-TekGen and DBpedia-WebNLG subsets of Text2KGBench, over 90% of AutoOntic's induced endpoint types are semantically aligned with the reference classes across two LLM backbones: about half match exactly, while most remaining differences concern granularity. On MINE, knowledge graphs organized using an ontology built by AutoOntic achieve 88% retrieval accuracy. AutoOntic is available at https://github.com/screemix/AutoOntic.

papers.title_en: GRASP: Query-Adaptive Graph Retrieval framework with Cross-Attention Scoring and Path Sufficiency Verification for Question Answering
papers.authors: Rui Xu, Le Wang, Tianyue Wang
papers.evidence: 面向知识图谱检索增强生成的查询自适应图检索与证据充分性验证
papers.tldr: 图检索增强生成需同时决定候选边打分、遍历何时停止与证据是否充分，现有方法多将三者割裂处理。GRASP以跨注意力打分器建模查询词元与候选边的细粒度交互，用学习式停止门依据查询、遍历状态与跳数自适应控制检索深度，并由充分性分类器在生成前判断路径是否完备、不足则触发重检索。在三个生物医学问答基准上，其不支持论断率降低8.9%至13.2%，候选密度越高收益越明显。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval quality is a key factor in the reliability of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), particularly when retrieval is performed over structured knowledge graphs. Graph-based retrieval requires decisions about candidate-edge scoring, traversal termination, and the sufficiency of the retrieved evidence. We propose GRASP, a query-adaptive graph retrieval framework that jointly addresses these decisions during the retrieval process. A cross-attention scorer models fine-grained interactions between individual query tokens and candidate edges, providing query-specific signals for edge selection. A learned stopping gate conditions traversal termination on the query, traversal state, and hop depth, allowing the retrieval depth to adapt to the current retrieval state. A sufficiency classifier further evaluates the assembled path before generation and triggers re-retrieval when the evidence is predicted to be incomplete. We evaluate GRASP on three biomedical question-answering benchmarks with different graph scales and answer lengths, using biomedical question answering as a representative setting for evaluating graph-based RAG retrieval. GRASP consistently improves over the strongest learned baseline across the evaluated retrieval and generation metrics. The unsupported-claim rate is reduced by 8.9% to 13.2% across the three benchmarks, with the largest reduction on the benchmark with the longest generated answers. The retrieval gains are more pronounced under higher candidate density, while ablation results indicate that the three components provide complementary improvements.

papers.title_en: Security of Deep Research Agents: Attack Surface, Defenses, Benchmarks, and Agenda Seeding against Research Planning
papers.authors: Yang Luo, Guangpu Chen, Yichen Liu, Zhaoyu Chen, Yifeng Gao, Zhiyang Ding, Qingni Shen, Zhonghai Wu
papers.evidence: 深度研究智能体安全中的RAG投毒、提示注入与评测缺口
papers.tldr: 深度研究智能体自动抓取开放网络内容并生成带引用的报告，其结论常被直接采信，安全风险却缺乏系统研究。本文按检索、规划、证据整合、报告生成四阶段构建统一威胁模型、攻防分类与评测基准，编码34项研究后发现仅26.5%涉及规划阶段，且无对商业产品的端到端投毒评测。为此提出议程投毒攻击：攻击者不写任何指令，只植入一个虚构评价指标。3520次沙盒实验显示GEO与提示注入几乎无效，议程投毒使目标在16%–28%报告中成为首选，注入检测与查询锚定均失效。
papers.abstract_en: Deep research and agentic search agents autonomously retrieve content from the open web and generate reports with citations, and their outputs are often taken directly as research conclusions. This paper systematizes security research in this area along four stages, namely retrieval, planning, evidence integration, and report generation. We present a unified threat model, a taxonomy of attacks and defenses, and a review of evaluation benchmarks, and we align the area dimension by dimension with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) poisoning, prompt injection, and generative engine optimization (GEO). Coding 34 primary studies shows that only 26.5% of them involve the planning stage, and none performs an end-to-end poisoning evaluation on commercial products. To address this gap, we propose the agenda seeding attack, in which the attacker writes no instructions and only introduces a fictitious evaluation metric. Across 3,520 sandboxed research runs under the same budget, GEO and prompt injection are nearly ineffective, whereas agenda seeding makes the attacker's target the top pick in 16% to 28% of reports. Injection detection and query anchoring fail against it, verification prompting hurts utility, and our proposed provenance tagging preserves utility but can be bypassed by multi-site bait. Finally, we propose eight research directions.

papers.title_en: KnowledgeClaw: Towards Agentic Knowledge Engineering via Omnimodal Hypergraphs
papers.authors: Haoran Luo, Jiapu Wang, Linhao Luo, Luu Anh Tuan
papers.evidence: 构建全模态类型化超图知识库并结合图检索增强生成的智能体化知识工程
papers.tldr: 现有知识工程系统难以同时满足全模态、闭环生命周期与多粒度应用，且缺少统一评测。为此，作者形式化OmniKE并发布OmniKE-Bench，含六项任务、1829个无模型条目与3960个真实文件。提出的KnowledgeClaw构建全模态类型超图，以闭环生命周期智能体维护更新，并按查询路由到合适粒度。在30个基线中六项任务均第一，OKE达55.9，较最强基线高14.6。
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge engineering (KE) turns raw files into a reasoning-ready knowledge base, a task now within reach of LLM agents. KE has progressed from chunk and graph retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to memory agents, agentic KE and multimodal KE. However, a live knowledge base needs omnimodality, a closed-loop lifecycle and multi-granular application at once, yet existing systems meet at most two and no benchmark measures all three. We formalize Omnimodal Knowledge Engineering (OmniKE) and release OmniKE-Bench, six tasks with 1,829 model-free items over 3,960 real files in five modalities. We further propose KnowledgeClaw, an agentic system that builds an omnimodal typed hypergraph, keeps it current with a closed-loop lifecycle agent and routes each query to the granularity it needs. Against 30 baselines, it ranks first on all six tasks with an overall OKE of 55.9, +14.6 over the strongest baseline. Our software and data are publicly available at https://github.com/LHRLAB/KnowledgeClaw.

papers.title_en: PIPETTE: Prompt Injection Purple-Teaming for Robust LLM Agents
papers.authors: Lipeng He, Yihan Wang, Jiawen Zhang, N. Asokan
papers.evidence: 间接提示注入攻击与LLM智能体鲁棒性
papers.tldr: LLM智能体需处理不可信外部数据，易受间接提示注入攻击；现有基于强化学习的红队方法虽能取得高攻击成功率，却常陷入模式崩溃，难以转化为防御鲁棒性提升。PIPETTE将红队发现与防御加固统一为紫队框架：用基于字典学习的奖励鼓励覆盖更多攻击策略，并配合面向间接提示注入的在策略对抗训练。在AgentDojo和ASB上，所得防御者对静态攻击成功率接近零，也能抵御强自适应攻击，同时良性任务效用接近无防御基线。该工作表明，提升攻击多样性是将红队发现转化为实际防御收益的关键。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents routinely interact with untrusted external data, exposing them to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks that hijack agents into executing attacker-chosen tasks. To uncover these vulnerabilities at scale, automated red-teaming methods often leverage reinforcement learning (RL) to generate attacks that achieve high attack success rates (ASR). Model developers use the attacks discovered during internal red-teaming to harden agents through adversarial training before deployment, a collaborative offensive-defensive process known in cybersecurity as purple-teaming. However, we show that achieving high ASR during red-teaming does not guarantee robustness gains from subsequent adversarial training. Specifically, we find that two state-of-the-art RL-based red-teaming methods, RL-Hammer and PISmith, suffer from mode collapse, repeatedly discovering similar attack strategies whose additional successes add no additional robustness improvements to adversarial training. To address this gap, we introduce PIPETTE, a unified prompt injection purple-teaming framework that effectively converts red-teaming discoveries into defender robustness improvements. PIPETTE employs a dictionary learning-based reward that encourages broader coverage of attack strategies during red-teaming. It also integrates an on-policy adversarial training pipeline tailored to IPI defense, enabling agents to resist attacks while completing legitimate user tasks. Extensive evaluations across agentic benchmarks (AgentDojo and ASB) demonstrate that PIPETTE produces defenders that achieve near-zero attack success rates on static attacks and can withstand strong adaptive attacks, while maintaining benign task utility close to that of the undefended baseline.

papers.title_en: LSP-RAG: Latent Scoring Perspectives for Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Haochen Liu, Guanghui Min, Song Wang, Yada Zhu, Chen Chen, Jundong Li
papers.evidence: 基于潜在评分的知识图谱检索增强生成
papers.tldr: 大语言模型在开放域问答中受训练语料不完整限制，事实准确性与多跳推理能力不足，知识图谱检索增强生成（KG-RAG）是可行方案。但现有方法或依赖ChatGPT等大模型引导检索、计算成本高，或用轻量模型时检索质量差，多跳场景尤为明显。LSP-RAG通过多视角提示打分增强逐跳知识图谱检索：每个潜在打分视角由视角专属软提示与随推理跳数演化的上下文软提示共同驱动，并对多个潜在视角自适应聚合以捕捉异构相关性信号。在多个KG问答基准上，该框架用轻量语言模型即超越依赖更大模型的检索系统，证明有限算力下也能实现准确鲁棒的多跳检索。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in open-domain question answering, but often struggle with factual accuracy and multi-hop reasoning due to the incompleteness of the training corpora. A promising solution is Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (KG-RAG), which supplements LLMs with structured knowledge retrieved from external knowledge graphs (KGs). However, existing KG-RAG methods either rely on large-scale language models (e.g., ChatGPT) to guide the retrieval process, which leads to high computational costs, or suffer from limited retrieval quality when using lightweight language models, particularly under multi-hop scenarios. We propose LSP-RAG (Latent Scoring Perspectives for Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Knowledge Graphs), a novel KG-RAG framework that enhances hop-wise KG knowledge retrieval through multi-perspective prompted scoring. Each latent scoring perspective is guided by a combination of two types of soft prompts: a perspective-specific soft prompt induces a distinct prompt-conditioned scoring function over candidate triplets, while a contextual soft prompt evolves with each reasoning hop by encoding the query and previously explored KG triplets, enabling the model to preserve consistency and relevance across multi-hop retrieval. Rather than assuming manually defined semantic roles, these latent perspectives are adaptively aggregated to capture heterogeneous relevance signals during retrieval. This design allows LSP-RAG to perform accurate and robust retrieval using lightweight language models. LSP-RAG achieves superior performance across multiple KG-based Question Answering benchmarks compared to existing retrieval systems, including those that rely on much larger language models, demonstrating its effectiveness under limited computational budgets.

papers.title_en: Interactive Structured Environment Scaling for Large Language Model Agentic Reasoning
papers.authors: Peng Yu, Luoyi Fu, Xinbing Wang, Ying Wen
papers.evidence: 面向大模型智能体推理的结构化与检索环境及子图检索
papers.tldr: 现有结构化/检索环境先抽取答案附近子图或固定段落，压缩候选空间并泄露答案位置，使路径选择等并非真实策略决策。RISE把结构化强化学习扩展到全尺度交互数据库：决策空间缩放用五阶段类型意图适配器暴露未剪枝知识图谱，并以调用预算和grounding奖励门控约束；学习前沿缩放结合结构层级推进与自进化能力前沿bandit，缓解组内方差塌缩。在19个基准和3个骨干上，RISE提升域内与未见schema知识图谱推理，零样本迁移到开放域段落检索，并增强域外数学与逻辑推理。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning via environmental interaction is a cornerstone post-training paradigm for evolving large language models into autonomous agents capable of multi-turn tool use and exploration. Because the environment defines what the policy observes and how actions are verified, its structure directly bounds the capabilities an agent can acquire. Yet existing structured and retrieval environments rely on upstream pre-filtering---extracting a compact subgraph around the gold answer or retrieving fixed passages before the policy acts. We show that such pre-filtering introduces a fundamental measurement confound: because per-question subgraphs enclose ground-truth paths, they compress the candidate space by orders of magnitude and leak answer locations via local topology, allowing a question-blind degree heuristic to surface gold answers far above chance. To restore path selection, candidate pruning, and optimal stopping as genuine policy decisions, we propose RISE (Interactive Structured Environment), which transitions structured reinforcement learning from static subgraphs to full-scale interactive databases along two coupled axes. First, Decision-Space Scaling exposes the unpruned knowledge graph via a five-stage graph-agnostic typed intent adapter under a bounded call budget and a multiplicative grounding reward gate. Second, Learning-Frontier Scaling overcomes within-group variance collapse under group-normalized objectives by uniting model-independent structural tier progression with a self-evolving competence-frontier bandit. Across nineteen benchmarks and three model backbones, RISE substantially advances in-domain and unseen-schema knowledge-graph reasoning, transfers zero-shot to open-domain passage retrieval, and significantly enhances out-of-domain mathematical and logical deduction.

papers.title_en: CausalDrive: Causal Decomposition for Data-Efficient End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Xiaobao Wei, Jingxian Wu, Lirong Yang, Qing Han, Yuan Gao, Ziwei Yang, Shuai Yang, Weiwei Liu, Chang Huang
papers.evidence: 端到端驾驶策略的因果分解，契合车载智能体的因果推理主题
papers.tldr: 端到端自动驾驶直接模仿专家轨迹时，会把“去哪里”的名义意图与“怎么开”的多模态风格纠缠在一起，削弱专家示范的利用效率。CausalDrive通过因果分解，将确定性的名义意图预测与概率式的风格执行建模分离，并利用反事实名义轨迹提供独立监督、用扩散策略学习风格残差。该方法在NAVSIM v1和v2上分别达到91.2 PDMS和89.5 EPDMS，匹配或超越现有方法。其贡献在于以结构化监督减少冗余学习，在有限数据和复杂交互场景中提升数据效率与驾驶表现。
papers.abstract_en: Efficient use of expert demonstrations is essential for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, directly imitating expert trajectories couples nominal intention, which specifies where the vehicle should go, with multimodal driving styles, which determine how that intention is executed. Different combinations of these factors can yield similar expert trajectories, obscuring their respective causal contributions and forcing the policy to learn both from a single entangled target. This ambiguity limits how effectively the policy can exploit expert demonstrations. We propose CausalDrive, a causal decomposition framework for data-efficient driving policy learning that separates deterministic nominal intention prediction from probabilistic driving style modeling. Specifically, we construct counterfactual nominal trajectories from navigation command, map topology, and ego state by removing style dependent effects, providing a Nominal Intention Planner with supervision independent of expert trajectories. Conditioned on the predicted nominal intention and surrounding agents, a diffusion-based Style Execution Policy models diverse driving styles as a multimodal distribution over residuals between nominal and expert trajectories. This causally structured supervision reduces redundant learning of shared nominal behavior in routine scenarios, directing expert supervision toward informative execution variations and improving data utilization. CausalDrive achieves 91.2 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 89.5 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, matching or surpassing state-of-the-art performance. Further experiments demonstrate strong performance with limited expert data and clear advantages in challenging interactive scenarios.

papers.title_en: Teaching VLMs What to Say, Not How to Reason: Rethinking Counterfactual Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
papers.evidence: 面向视觉语言模型驾驶决策的反事实推理与因果鲁棒性评测，契合反事实鲁棒性主题
papers.tldr: 针对VLM自动驾驶中反事实推理是否真正缓解捷径学习尚不明确的问题，本文系统检验CF推理对动作分布、推理不确定性与视觉注意的影响。结果显示CF推理使决策更保守并增加不确定性，且不改变视觉grounding。因果干预实验还发现掩蔽因果与非因果因素引发相近决策变化，表明CF推理更像语言捷径而非真正因果推理。
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving systems have been shown to suffer from shortcut learning and causal confusion, limiting their ability to generalize robustly under distribution shift. To mitigate these limitations, recent works based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have explored incorporating linguistic reasoning capabilities into driving decision-making, reporting improvements in driving performance. In particular, counterfactual (CF) reasoning has been proposed to enable self-reflective, high-level causal understanding. However, it remains unclear whether the language-based reasoning mitigates shortcut learning or merely shifts it from visual representations to linguistic patterns, creating an illusion of causal understanding. Moreover, existing approaches often conflate intervention-based reasoning with CF reasoning, leaving the effects of genuine CF reasoning unexplored. In this work, we examine what CF reasoning actually induces in VLM-based autonomous driving and observe that it shifts the action distribution toward more conservative behaviors while increasing uncertainty in reasoning and decision-making. This effect persists under reinforcement fine-tuning, suggesting that it is not merely a transient artifact. Furthermore, visual attention analysis shows that CF reasoning does not alter visual grounding, while causal intervention experiments reveal that masking causally relevant and non-causal factors in accident scenarios results in comparable decision change rates. Overall, these results suggest that CF reasoning does not induce genuine causal reasoning grounded in visual evidence. Instead, it acts as a linguistic shortcut that reshapes the action distribution, teaching models what to say but not how to reason, highlighting a gap between language-based reasoning and causal understanding in autonomous driving.

papers.title_en: NaviGATE: Noise-Aware Dual-View Generation for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
papers.authors: Jie Peng, Yongxue Shan, Yongfu Zha, Cui Miao, Xiaodong Wang
papers.evidence: 对噪声检索鲁棒的多模态知识图谱推理
papers.tldr: 多模态知识图谱推理需融合结构、文本与视觉证据，但嵌入方法表征固定，生成方法易受噪声检索干扰并产生无效实体。NaviGATE 对齐图结构与文本语义，并以多模态实体摘要和结构 token 微调语言模型，实现结构感知知识激活。其噪声感知双视图微调联合优化无检索与检索感知视图，强化可靠候选、抑制误导候选，推理时用结构约束解码限定有效实体。标准基准上它优于强基线，并在噪声检索下保持鲁棒。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal knowledge graph reasoning (MKGR) aims to infer missing facts by jointly exploiting relational structures, textual descriptions, and visual evidence. Existing embedding-based methods effectively capture graph topology, but their fixed multimodal representations are less effective for query-specific fine-grained semantic reasoning, while generation-based methods are vulnerable to noisy retrieval and may produce invalid entities. To address these challenges, we propose NaviGATE, a noise-aware generative framework for MKGR. NaviGATE first aligns graph-derived structural representations with textual semantics, then performs structure-aware internal knowledge activation by fine-tuning the multimodal language model with multimodal entity summaries and injected structural tokens. In the noise-aware dual-view instruction tuning stage, NaviGATE jointly optimizes retrieval-free and retrieval-aware views: reliable retrieved candidates are reinforced through contrastive logit sharpening, while misleading candidates are suppressed through parametric consistency distillation. In inference, structure-constrained decoding restricts generation to valid entities in the target knowledge graph. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that NaviGATE consistently outperforms strong unimodal, multimodal, and generation-based baselines, and remains robust under noisy retrieval scenarios.

papers.title_en: DRIFT: Detachable Reasoning for Runtime-Flexible and Efficient End-to-End Driving
papers.authors: Emad Aghajanzadeh, Bethany Anne Wong, Leonhard Kunze, Moritz Thoma, Maximilian Forstenhäusler, Nael Fasfous, Manoj Rohit Vemparala, Pierpaolo Mori, Christos Anagnostopoulos, Daniel Mueller-Gritschneder, Ulf Schlichtmann
papers.evidence: 面向端到端驾驶的轻量语言推理与场景描述
papers.tldr: 将视觉语言模型引入端到端自动驾驶虽能提升场景描述与推理，但其计算开销大，且运行时开关语言推理难以保持闭环性能。DRIFT用轻量语言模型接收投影后的驾驶表征，生成问答与动作解说，并训练可切换的运行时柔性规划模块。仅255M参数在Bench2Drive上取得97.03驾驶分数和89.39%成功率，并在NAVSIM、AlpaSim保持竞争力。该工作证明可按部署约束绕过语言模型而不牺牲驾驶表现，为紧凑高效端到端驾驶提供新路径。
papers.abstract_en: The integration of vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has demonstrated strong potential by providing scene description and reasoning capabilities. However, VLMs are computationally expensive, and switching language reasoning on and off at runtime without hurting closed-loop performance has not been demonstrated, which hinders practical adoption. To address these issues, we propose DRIFT, an E2E autonomous driving framework that integrates a lightweight language model (LM) for visual question answering and action commentary. By efficiently projecting intermediate driving representations into the language embedding space, we demonstrate that a compact LM (<150M parameters) can achieve strong scene description and action commentary. Furthermore, we introduce a runtime-flexible planning module that is trained on surrogate reasoning features distilled from the LM and can be conditioned on either the LM or the surrogate reasoning features at inference. This design enables bypassing the LM entirely when required by deployment constraints, without sacrificing driving performance. With only 255M parameters, DRIFT reaches up to a Driving Score (DS) of 97.03 and a Success Rate of 89.39% (mean over three runs) on Bench2Drive by interleaving its LM and surrogate reasoning at a chosen reasoning rate. This is on par with the strongest non-language models while being far more compact than existing VLM-based models. DRIFT further achieves competitive results on the real-world NAVSIM and AlpaSim benchmarks at significantly lower computational cost than existing VLM-based approaches. Project page: https://drift-e2e.github.io/

papers.title_en: Causals: An Open Knowledge Graph for Research on Causal Reasoning
papers.authors: Miaozhe Lin, Qiongzheng Lin, Zhongwei Liang, Zijun Liu
papers.evidence: 支持因果与多跳推理的开放知识图谱表示
papers.tldr: 将因果知识应用到新事件，需把事件与相关实体及其后果展开关系连接起来。作者构建开放知识图谱 Causals，从新闻报道抽取事件、组织、商品、金融工具等实体与关系。初始版含 369,184 个节点和 1,272,418 条边，区分结构关系、观测与归因因果主张并保留来源链接。该资源刻画连通性与多跳检索特性，为语言模型检索上下文并应用因果机制提供共享知识，并以 CC BY 4.0 开放且邀请贡献本体、记录与证据。
papers.abstract_en: Applying causal knowledge to a new event requires connecting the event to relevant entities and the relationships through which its consequences may unfold. We present Causals, an open knowledge graph for research on this form of reasoning. Its initial release, constructed from news reports, contains 369,184 nodes and 1,272,418 edges linking reported events, organizations, commodities, financial instruments, and other entities. Structural relationships, observations, and attributed causal claims retain distinct semantics and links to source records. We describe the construction and representation of the resource and characterize its connectivity and multi-hop retrieval properties. Causals provides shared relational knowledge for studying how language models retrieve relevant context and apply mechanisms to particular events. The dataset is available under CC BY 4.0 at https://causals.org/, and we invite contributions to its ontology, records, and evidence.

papers.title_en: Ground, Iterate, Trace: Decomposing AI Research Ideation
papers.authors: Samson Yu, Qiran Zou, Jing Yu Lim, Rushi Shah, Anirudh Goyal, Dianbo Liu
papers.evidence: 智能体构建语义知识图谱并使用图检索工具
papers.tldr: 大模型能生成看似合理的研究想法，但其有效性来源与创新如何从既有文献产生仍不清楚。CAR框架用文献语义知识图谱、图检索工具及四种概念算子进行迭代构思，并记录每步变换与文献来源。在40个LiveIdeaBench主题和两个执行基准上，CAR方法新颖性显著高于单次提示与The AI Scientist，可行性优于RIA，执行胜率最高。消融未证实显式算子稳定带来质量增益，但贡献在于将构思质量与可追踪过程分离。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have been widely used to generate plausible research ideas, yet it remains unclear what makes automated ideation effective and how generated novel proposals arise from prior scientific work. We introduce the Creative AI Researcher (CAR), an agentic framework combining literature grounding, iterative development and explicit conceptual operators. CAR constructs a semantic knowledge graph from retrieved literature and equips an ideation agent with graph-retrieval tools and four operators: bisociation, analogy, exploration and elaboration. Each operator call is checked against structural acceptance conditions and recorded, producing a trace of intermediate transformations and declared literature sources. We evaluate CAR with two language-model backbones across 40 LiveIdeaBench research topics and two execution benchmarks. CAR achieves significantly higher methodological novelty (MN) than single-shot prompting and The AI Scientist. Its methodological novelty does not differ significantly from the Research Ideation Agent, while its feasibility scores are higher on both backbones. With a shared experiment executor, CAR achieves the highest pairwise win rate among the evaluated AI methods on FML-bench-Lite and BioXArena. In a ten-condition ablation study, MN point estimates favor CAR over one-step proposal on both backbones, but no MN contrast survives correction for multiple comparisons. The results do not establish a consistent quality benefit from explicit operators beyond free-form iteration. CAR makes the sequence of operations and declared literature sources inspectable, separating judged idea quality from procedural traceability.

papers.title_en: STARK: Moving towards Personalized Agents That Truly Learn and Remember
papers.authors: Aryan Jain, Abhishek Jha, Anish Nediyanchath, Promod Yenigalla
papers.evidence: 面向个性化智能体的双图记忆架构，存储情景与洞察知识
papers.tldr: 长时记忆对个性化智能体至关重要，但现有架构多记录“发生了什么”，把“为何发生”留给底层大模型，且用户知识彼此孤立。STARK提出双图记忆架构，将事件同时作为行为洞察的边：情节图记录时序、因果与语义关联的交互，洞察图存储大模型抽取的行为信号并由支持事件连接。推理时直接从洞察节点检索行为知识，避免重复遍历情节图，并支持跨用户迁移以缓解冷启动。实验在LongMemEval、LoCoMo和LongLaMP上取得稳定提升。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is essential for personalized agentic systems that interact with users over long time periods, yet current architectures only capture what happened while leaving the reasoning of why it happened to be derived later by underlying LLMs.%, and silo knowledge within individual users. These events can, however, convey not only what a user experienced but also how that experience shaped their behavioral patterns. We introduce STARK, a dual-graph memory architecture which treats these events not just as nodes but also as edges between behavioral insights. STARK maintains an Episodic Graph which records interactions as temporally, causally, and semantically linked episodes; and an Insight Graph which represents LLM-extracted behavioral signals scored by how many events support them, connected by the very events that led to them. At inference, behavioral knowledge is retrieved directly from insight nodes grounded by event-as-edges, eliminating repeated episodic traversal. The event-as-edge structure also naturally enables projecting the knowledge graph into a relational embedding space where cross-user transfer becomes possible under shared contextual circumstances, allowing the system to infer missing insights for cold-start users. Evaluations show that STARK improves by 1.48 judge score on LongMemEval information extraction and 0.93 on LoCoMo open domain questions over state of the art. On the public LongLaMP abstract-generation benchmark, cross-user transfer improves open-ended judge scores by 0.7 points and ROUGE-L by 3 at 5% graph sparsity.

papers.title_en: GenSPARQL: A Generative Extension of SPARQL for Incomplete Knowledge Graphs
papers.authors: Jingcheng Wu, Yi Wang, Hongkuan Zhou, Steffen Staab, Bo Xiong
papers.evidence: 面向知识图谱的LLM增强SPARQL查询与推理
papers.tldr: 知识图谱普遍不完整，而SPARQL只能从已存储的三元组作答，无法利用大语言模型补全缺失事实。为此，GenSPARQL在SPARQL 1.1中引入GENOP算子，在查询求值时将LLM生成的值绑定到查询变量，并通过相似度连接把生成的名字映射到图中的实体IRI。查询规划器仅针对其他图模式和过滤器选出的绑定调用LLM，避免逐绑定重复调用。实验用三个开放权重LLM，嵌入相似度成功映射83%的实体且仅产生一个错误匹配。
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graphs on the Web are incomplete, and SPARQL answers a query only from the stored triples. Large language models (LLMs) can predict missing facts, but an LLM returns names instead of IRIs and requires one call per binding of a query variable. We present GenSPARQL, a generative extension of SPARQL 1.1 with an operator GENOP that binds values generated by an LLM to query variables during query evaluation. A similarity join maps generated names to entities of the graph, and the query planner invokes the LLM only for the bindings selected by the other graph patterns and filters. In a web workbench, attendees query two graphs built from Wikidata and inspect generated values, mapped entities and LLM calls. In our evaluation with three open-weight LLMs, the embedding similarity maps 83% of the entities named by the LLMs and yields only one incorrect match.
